scenario.combat1802: Dev scenario: booklet set-up without adjustment, turn 1, Soviet draw pile E17, E01, E11, E02, E03. Run bot impulse: the 1st Guards Army attacks 1802, the combat sheet opens.
scenario.nkvd: Dev scenario: booklet set-up without adjustment, turn 1, Soviet draw pile E08. Run bot impulse: NKVD Operations puts two hits on the German stack in 0205.

page.title: Situation map
page.viewport: Game map: drag or arrow keys to pan, wheel or + and - to zoom, 0 to fit
page.hideUnitsTitle: Hide the counters to read the map under them (U)
page.sovietSupplyTitle: Show the supply path of every Soviet unit on the map (S)
page.germanSupplyTitle: Show the supply path of every German unit on the map (G)
page.undoHint: Undo takes back the last action and removes it from the log. Arrow keys move the map.
page.overlaysHint: Lay a sheet on the map to check what the bot reads from it.
page.combatNone: No combat in progress: the tab opens by itself when one begins.

legend.title: Bot moves legend
legend.trail: Path a Soviet unit walked in the last activation. Clear trails removes it.
legend.chosen: Current hex of the unit inspected in the bot decision details panel.
legend.dropped: Hexes set aside by the bot, because of a preference, a restriction or a tiebreaker.

home.title: EA Kharkov Bot
home.intro: Soviet bot for Enemy Action: Kharkov, German Solo.
home.mapText: The game map, with overlays showing what the bot reads from it
home.calibrationText: Hex grid, background image, saved to data/map-grid.json
home.painterText: Paint per-hex and per-side engine data, saved to data/map-hexes.json and data/map-hexsides.json
home.unitsIndexText: Every known unit counter with its decoded data, for checking against data/units.json (2.3)
home.sovietCardsText: Each Soviet card scan beside what the bot reads from data/soviet-cards.json (4.1)

route.riverCloser: across a river, closer to its objective

no.marsh: a mechanized unit does not advance into marsh
no.townProximate: a German unit would become proximate to {{town}}
no.mapEdgeVacated: map-edge VP hex {{hex}} would be left vacant
no.cutsSupply: {{unit}} would be unable to trace supply
no.surrounded: the hex is surrounded or nearly surrounded
no.secondHex: no second hex to advance into
no.joined: joined by a combat tactic: no advance (12.8)
no.moved: no longer next to the attacked hex

noCard.overwhelming: No card drawn: the attack is overwhelming (12.38).
noCard.unsupported: No card drawn: the attack is not in Soviet support (12.3).
noCard.noCards: No card drawn: no Soviet card left in the draw pile or the discard pile.

aux.noTactic: no combat tactic for an attack this turn

no.partisans: not against a woods, town or city hex
no.townCity: not against a town or city

adj.rivers: all attackers across the Donets or Dniepr
adj.isolated: all your units isolated: Soviet hits ignored
adj.dispersedOrOos: all your units dispersed or out of supply

no.intelligence: Soviet Intelligence: no German combat tactic in this combat
no.noneSupplied: none of your units in the combat is supplied and undispersed (12.3)
no.townCity: not in a town or city: {{hex}}
no.pullOutDispersed: not with a dispersed or isolated unit
no.pullOutRoute: no two-hex retreat ending in German supply

combatSheet.byNkvd: Card {{card}}: two hits as if combat occurred.

reserves.none: No reserve placed: the attack did not need one, or none could be.

tactics.cardFromDiscard: Card {{card}}, drawn from the discard pile (12.37): {{name}}
tactics.ipRemoved: The IP in the hex is removed.
tactics.auxStays: Auxiliary card {{card}} stays in its box: {{why}}.
tactics.cardNoTactic: Card drawn {{card}}: no combat tactic for an attack this turn.

yourTactics.hint: Tick the cards you play from your hand. A German Army or Army Group South card counts as any tactic (12.33).
yourTactics.reinforceHint: Reinforce Battle: first drag one stack into {{hex}}.

chits.draw: chits to draw from the cup
chits.note: The Soviets always draw the maximum (12.4). Never fewer than {{min}}, the steps of your units.
chits.keep: Keep a chit when one of its sides holds

hits.hint: Enter only the hits printed on the chits you kept. The total can be negative (D−1 chits): the bot adds the hits due to the situation.

losses.choose: Choose how your units take them (12.52):
losses.pullOut: Pull Out: your units retreat two hexes, without Dispersed marker, ending in German supply.
losses.how: Then do it on the map: right-click a counter to remove a step (Eliminate on its last step); drag the stack to retreat, one hex at a time. Only the hexes open to the retreat accept it (12.7), lit on the map. A retreat into a hex in Soviet control costs one more step.
losses.nkvdTwo: Two hits, as if combat occurred

soviet.none: No hit on the Soviet units.
soviet.reduced: 12.55: {{count}} hits fewer, your units all eliminated.
soviet.first: First hit: {{unit}} loses a step (12.6: most steps, then the higher selector).
soviet.firstTied: First hit: {{unit}} loses a step, drawn among {{units}} (12.6).
soviet.parenthetical: fewer than four cards in the Soviet draw pile
soviet.nkvd: One step from the adjacent Soviet units (12.6): {{unit}}.
soviet.nkvdNone: No Soviet unit is left next to the hex.

advance.held: Your units still hold {{hex}}: no advance.
advance.intro: Your units left {{hex}}. Each Soviet unit checks its advance, lowest selector first (12.83).

cleanUp.reused: {{card}} back in the Soviet draw pile, shuffled: its tactic says Re-use (12.32).

target.choose: Several German stacks tie for the two hits: choose one.

germanAttack.later: The next steps of a German attack (your tactics, the Soviet card, the chits and the hits) are not on this sheet yet. Cancel the attack to go on with your impulse.

germanBar.label: German impulse
germanBar.hint: Drag a counter to move it; the hexes it can reach light up.
germanBar.pickAttackers: Click your attacking units. Shift+click takes a whole stack.
germanBar.pickTarget: Click the Soviet hex to attack, or more of your units.
germanBar.combatOpen: Combat on {{hex}}: the Combat tab leads it.
